pr.description: PR number opened, or null if none

criteria.description: One entry per acceptance criterion from the issue

evidence.description: Test name or file:line proving it, or why it is unmet

schemaTouched.description: True if server/db/schema.ts or drizzle/ changed — human applies the prod migration

scratchDb.description: pgmanager scratch database the schema change was verified against, for cleanup

screenshots.description: Uploaded screenshot URLs embedded in the PR (required, non-empty, whenever the diff touches app/ or components/)

contractsPosted.description: Cross-cutting decisions posted to the tracking issue

notes.description: Punts, adjacent problems noticed, decisions a reviewer should scrutinize
